description: Sample code demonstrating how to call the qhull library functions from an application, including convex hull, Delaunay triangulation, and halfspace intersection computations.

methods.name: print_summary
methods.description: Prints the number of vertices and facets with their normals.

methods.name: makecube
methods.description: Sets points to vertices of a cube.

methods.name: adddiamond
methods.description: Adds a diamond shape to the convex hull.

methods.name: makeDelaunay
methods.description: Generates points for Delaunay triangulation projected onto a paraboloid.

methods.name: addDelaunay
methods.description: Adds points to an existing Delaunay triangulation.

methods.name: findDelaunay
methods.description: Finds the Delaunay triangle or adjacent triangle closest to a point.

methods.name: makehalf
methods.description: Sets points to halfspaces for a diamond.

methods.name: addhalf
methods.description: Adds halfspaces for a cube to the intersection.
